name: Sincerely the Past
source:
The player follows Amos, a part-time postal worker trying to save up some extra cash. At their job they deliver mail to a small, but personable, penpal group. Along the way Amos starts to befriend this small group of individuals.

But wait...

There's more...

Can Amos * SAFELY * deliver these letters? Or will they be stopped by a penpal thief?!

[From [url=https://team-posties.itch.io/sealed-with-a-kiss-2025]itch.io[/url]]
